name: Fanuc Driver for ROS Jazzy
onCreateCommand: apt update && apt install git x11-xserver-utils python3-rosdep build-essential python3-colcon-common-extensions tmux && . /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.sh && rosdep init; rosdep update && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -y
postCreateCommand: for d in /cws/src/FANUC-CORPORATION/fanuc_driver/.git/modules/fanuc_libs/dependencies/sockpp /cws/src/FANUC-CORPORATION/fanuc_driver/.git/modules/fanuc_libs/dependencies/readerwriterqueue /cws/src/FANUC-CORPORATION/fanuc_driver/.git/modules/fanuc_libs/dependencies/yaml-cpp /cws/src/FANUC-CORPORATION/fanuc_driver/.git/modules/fanuc_libs/dependencies/reflect-cpp; do git config --global --add safe.directory $d; done && . /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.sh && colcon build --symlink-install --cmake-args -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF && . ./install/setup.sh
